title: Fission Description
description: Essential Criteria: Clearly describe the nuclear fission process and its initiation.

title: Energy Release Explanation
description: Essential Criteria: Accurately explain why energy is released during fission and provide the correct energy value.

title: Radioactivity Reasoning
description: Essential Criteria: Explain why the fission products are radioactive, focusing on neutron-to-proton ratios.

title: Moderator Necessity
description: Important Criteria: Discuss the role of a moderator in a fission reactor and the preference for light elements.

title: Binding Energy Concept
description: Important Criteria: Include a brief mention of binding energy differences between heavy and medium nuclei.

title: Units and Values
description: Optional Criteria: Use appropriate units when stating energy values and ensure they are consistent.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common mistakes such as incorrect energy values or misunderstanding of neutron interactions.
